about: A tool that turns a codebase, with its docs, configs and schemas, into a knowledge graph that coding assistants can query.

prs.title: Maven projects no longer get made-up dependencies
prs.broken: graphify read every dependency listed anywhere in a Maven pom file, including version pins and plugin dependencies. A parent project that only pins versions showed up as depending on all its modules.
prs.changed: Only the dependencies a project really declares, at the top level or in a profile, become links in the graph.
prs.matters: The graph of a multi-module Java build shows how its parts really depend on each other.
